lines.en: From the left?
An honorable tactic!
From the right?

An aggressive
attack!

I am embarrassed
for you.

There is no honor
in being weak.

That attack was not
at all effective.

Your technique is
seriously flawed.

You are starting to
anger me!
Urrrrrk!

I will not tolerate
you any longer!
lines.ru:
Больше я тебя
терпеть не стану!

lines.en:
You won't finish me
off so easily!
Aaarrrgghh!

You will be difficult
to defeat!

I will overcome the
pain you cause me!

I cannot be defeated!
I am too strong!
lines.ru:
Меня не победить! Я
слишком силён!

lines.en:
I have dishonored
the Kingdom!

I know that my loss
will be avenged!

I will always regret
this ignoble defeat!
lines.ru:
Вечно буду жалеть о
позорном поражении!

lines.en:
You will be defeated
soon enough!

Show courage! Don't
attack from behind!
lines.ru:
Будь смелее! Не бей в
спину!

lines.en: Aarrgghh!!
Hmmph!

I move quickly for
an old man, eh?!

Do you think you
can hit me? Do you?!

You fight without
skill or honor!
lines.ru:
Ты бьёшься без
умения и чести!

lines.en: You--!!
Damn it!
What?!

I will not miss
you again!

Your blows are too
weak to hurt me!

Soon, it will be MY
turn to strike!

I have never lost a
battle!
lines.ru:
Я не проиграл ни
одного боя!

lines.en:
I will claim this
victory, not you!
lines.ru:
Эта победа будет
моей, не твоей!

lines.en: Too easy!
A trifling attack!
Haaaaaah!
Errrggh?!

That was no attack!
That was a joke!

I must have revealed
my attack somehow!
lines.ru:
Видно, я как-то
выдал свой удар!

lines.en:
I will not allow the
Empire to succeed!

I will not rest until
we crush the Empire!
lines.ru:
Не успокоюсь, пока не
сокрушим Империю!

lines.en: Begone, feeble foe!

The Kingdom will
be triumphant!
Grrrrrr!!
Rrauugh!!
Take this, fool!

No mercy for allies
of the Empire!

Will you run away,
or surrender?!
Rrraaaahhhh!

Go ahead! Make my
day!

Repent for your
wicked ways!

Your ATAC will soon
be scrap!

You fight as if blind,
deaf, and dumb!
lines.ru:
Ты бьёшься, как
слепой и глухой!

lines.en: What's that?!
